task.description:
Owner request (2026-10-11): Zinc is for education, makers, artists and DIY, and nobody outside the project has walked its first run. Walk it as a newcomer on the development Mac: install, `zinc doctor`, `zinc new` with each template, `zinc run`, a first change, a first mistake, `zinc dev`. Fix on the way what takes less than an hour; the rest is lines for `backlog/later.md`.

Second lane of the parallel agents, after the pinball and the museum (owner's order, `backlog/priority.json`).

acceptanceCriteria.text: a scripted test creates a project from every template of templates/ in an empty directory, runs it headless for a few frames and passes; a template that fails is fixed

six beginner mistakes (a misspelt import, a type error, an unknown zinc: module, a plugin that is not installed, a JSX tag left open, a missing file) each print the file, the line and what to do next; the messages are goldens
docs/guide/01-getting-started.md follows the tested path command for command, from the install to a changed line seen on screen, and says what a teacher, a maker and an artist can open next
what the walk found and did not fix is given as lines for backlog/later.md

task.title: First five minutes: install, zinc new, run and a first error, walked as a beginner
